title_o: A word-order constraint on phonological activation
verdict_reason: F1RT_readyforanalysis.sav (osf.io/d3mpe; 24 subjects x congruent/incongruent means) holds the object-naming group (n=12 = N.R); a paired t-test gives t(11)=-1.88, p=.087, dz=.543, matching the table (p .09, dz .548, which is 1.9/sqrt(12) from the rounded t).

data_files.notes: Per-subject condition means; 12 colour-naming and 12 object-naming ('naming') subjects
Trial-level data (Subject, NamingTask, Item, RT, Errors, Condition, ...); the aggregation into F1 was not re-derived
By-item means (F2), not used for the key test

key_test.test: paired t-test of congruent vs incongruent mean naming RT, object-naming subjects only (by-subjects F1)

obstacles: Key test runs on pre-aggregated means; deriving them from alldata.sav (error/outlier rules in the .sps) was not checked
Audit script's nrow(subjects)/2 is the per-task n; the two tasks have different subjects
